courses.title: RTL to GDSII: Complete ASIC Tapeout & Physical Design Flow
courses.tagline: From Verilog RTL to Floorplanning, Clock Tree Synthesis, and Sign-off STA for sub-14nm Silicon
courses.description: Master the complete silicon implementation journey. You will take a high-frequency RISC-V SoC subsystem from synthesizable RTL through logical synthesis, floorplanning, placement, clock tree synthesis (CTS), routing, Static Timing Analysis (STA), and DRC/LVS physical sign-off.
courses.targetRole: Physical Design Engineer / STA Sign-off Engineer

modules.title: Module 1: Front-End RTL Synthesis & SDC Timing Constraints

content.summary: Deep dive into create_clock, set_clock_uncertainty, set_input_delay, and multi-cycle paths.
keyTakeaways: How clock uncertainty accounts for clock jitter and fabrication variation.
Specifying input and output delays relative to virtual and physical clocks.
False paths vs. multi-cycle path definitions for real-world bus protocols.
content.theoryText: Static Timing Analysis (STA) verifies that every registered path satisfies setup (max-delay) and hold (min-delay) constraints.

content.summary: Transform RTL into cell gates while meeting Power, Performance, and Area (PPA) targets.
keyTakeaways: Standard cell library LEF/Liberty (.lib) format parsing.
High-effort timing-driven logic structuring vs area recovery.
content.theoryText: Logic synthesis converts HDL code (Verilog/VHDL) into technology-specific gate-level representations.

courses.title: Advanced SystemVerilog & UVM Design Verification (DV) Elite
courses.tagline: Build industry-grade reusable UVM testbenches, assertions, coverage models, and scoreboards
courses.description: Design Verification makes up 70% of modern chip design cycles. Master SystemVerilog OOP, constrained-random stimulus generation, functional coverage, SystemVerilog Assertions (SVA), and full Universal Verification Methodology (UVM 1.2) components.

modules.title: Module 1: SystemVerilog OOP for Verification Architecture

lessons.title: Classes, Inheritance, Virtual Methods, and Polymorphism

content.summary: Master OOP principles specifically as applied to hardware verification testbenches.
keyTakeaways: Virtual methods enabling run-time polymorphism for drivers and scoreboards.
content.theoryText: SystemVerilog OOP enables modular verification architectures.

courses.title: Embedded Linux, RTOS & Device Driver Development
courses.tagline: Kernel internals, FreeRTOS scheduling, DMA drivers, and board bring-up for ARM Cortex & RISC-V
courses.description: Bridge hardware and software. Learn how to write Linux Character & Platform Device Drivers, configure Device Trees, build customized BSPs with Yocto, and implement real-time multi-threaded applications on FreeRTOS and Zephyr.

content.summary: Understand how real-time schedulers switch context in sub-microsecond intervals.
keyTakeaways: Preemptive scheduling guarantees highest-priority ready task executes.
content.theoryText: In hard real-time systems, predictability takes precedence over throughput.

courses.title: TinyML & Edge AI Silicon Acceleration
courses.tagline: Quantize, prune, and deploy deep neural networks on microcontrollers and custom NPU silicon cores
courses.description: Discover how modern edge computing brings intelligence directly onto milliwatt silicon chips. Learn INT8/INT4 Post-Training Quantization, systolic array matrix-multiplication hardware accelerators, and TensorFlow Lite for Microcontrollers.
courses.targetRole: Edge AI Engineer / NPU Architecture Specialist

lessons.title: Floating Point FP32 to Fixed-Point INT8 Quantization Math

content.summary: Learn the mathematical mapping between real numbers and 8-bit integers for 4x memory savings.

enquiries.subject: Inquiry on Sub-14nm Clock Tree Synthesis Skew Bounds
enquiries.message: Hello Ample Team, during CTS in the SkyWater flow, my clock insertion delay is 1.2ns but clock skew between memory macro clock pins and register clocks is 85ps. Is this acceptable for the upcoming tapeout sign-off?

enquiries.subject: UVM Sequence Arbitration in AXI Crossbar Testbench
enquiries.message: Could you provide guidance on setting SEQ_ARB_STRICT_FIFO vs SEQ_ARB_WEIGHTED when two virtual sequences contend for the address write phase driver?
enquiries.reply: Hi Sneha, excellent question. In commercial AXI testbenches, use SEQ_ARB_WEIGHTED with priority tags so write-response transactions do not starve under high slave latency.

enquiries.subject: Embedded Linux Device Tree binding for SPI Flash controller
enquiries.message: Our custom FPGA board boots U-Boot, but the kernel panics while probing the QSPI flash node in DTB. Can an instructor review my dts snippet?
enquiries.reply: Under review by Aditya V. Reddy. Please ensure the compatible string matches jedec,spi-nor.
